hooks.command: input=$(cat); f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' <<< "$input"); if [[ -n "$f" && "$f" =~ \.(ts|tsx|astro)$ ]]; then out=$(npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg out "$out" '{"decision":"block","reason":"ESLint found unfixable errors","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":("ESLint errors in edited file:\n" + $out)}}'; fi; fi; exit 0

input=$(cat); f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' <<< "$input"); if [[ -n "$f" && "$f" =~ \.(ts|tsx|astro)$ ]]; then out=$(npm run typecheck --silent 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg out "$out" '{"decision":"block","reason":"Type errors found","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":("Type errors after editing:\n" + $out)}}'; fi; fi; exit 0
